text: {"table": {"name": "order", "purpose": "Permanent standing payment orders (direct debit / payment orders) from bank accounts, as in the PKDD'99 Czech bank dataset. Each row is one recurring payment order issued by an account to an external bank account, with an amount and a payment category symbol."}, "columns": {"col_001": {"role": "identifier", "name": "order_id", "description": "Primary key of the payment order; unique integer identifier.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_002": {"role": "foreign_key", "name": "account_id", "description": "Owning bank account that issues the payment order; references account.col_001 (many orders per account). The LLM-suggested joins to client/disp are spurious — the statistical join to account is the correct one.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_003": {"role": "code", "name": "bank_code", "description": "Code of the receiving bank (13 anonymized two-letter codes, roughly uniform). Identifies which bank the beneficiary account is held at.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_004": {"role": "identifier", "name": "recipient_account_number", "description": "Account number of the beneficiary at the receiving bank; near-unique large integers, consistent with anonymized account numbers.", "status": "tentative"}, "col_005": {"role": "numeric", "name": "amount", "description": "Payment amount in Czech koruna (CZK); positive values from 1 to 14,882, median ~2,596.", "status": "resolved"}, "col_006": {"role": "code", "name": "payment_symbol", "description": "Czech bank payment symbol (k_symbol) categorizing the payment: SIPO = household/utility payments, POJISTNE = insurance, UVER = loan repayment, LEASING = leasing; empty string = no symbol/other.", "status": "resolved"}}}
